change: Opt-in hierarchical profiling and scoped Windows HighQoS at native realtime entry points.

method.hardware: Intel Core i9-13980HX, Windows 11, CPUExecutionProvider; RTX 4060 unused by inference.

benchmark.micro_sampling: uniform across each whole video; sequential decode; interleaved videos
benchmark.inference: prepared CPU tensor to returned CPU outputs, including GPU transfers/synchronization
benchmark.capture_to_result: submission to result, including worker queue; excludes camera/driver
benchmark.scheduled_to_result: scheduled video PTS to result, including producer lateness
benchmark.excluded: preview/UI rendering, network, Re-ID, final image saving; models warm before replay
benchmark.startup: new model sessions in an existing Python process; OS file cache not flushed

method.profiling: Exclusive spans reconcile to root wall time. Inclusive parent/child times overlap. Decode is on a separate producer lane. Instrumented FPS is not acceptance throughput.
method.pooling: Concatenate all processed-frame total timings before percentiles; sum processed / sum elapsed for FPS.
limitations: System load and CPU frequency were not locked; baseline B was as fast or faster than optimized.
Two videos establish regression parity on these inputs, not broad model accuracy.
No UI, preview, network, ReID or final file saving in acceptance timers.
No energy measurement. HighQoS is process-wide and restored; affinity and priority class unchanged.
Only caller CPU placement was sampled, not all ORT worker threads.

worker_threads.decision: Keep ORT 4 and OpenCV 1; alternatives did not show stable gains.
worker_threads.method: Real inputs sampled by reservoir over complete videos. Three thread counts 1/2/4, three rounds rotating execution order; 48 calls per setting per round for ORT, 2ms idle between calls. Contiguous FP32 inputs for isolated ORT microbenchmarks. OpenCV ABCCBA blocks; preserves sampled row strides. No deployment or accuracy changes accepted from microbenchmarks alone.

dispatch.method: Single process, unchanged four-thread ORT sessions and cv1; ABCCBA process-only scheduling changes. 48 calls per stage and mode after 12 warmups, 2ms idle between calls; identical stored real inputs. No system-wide settings or other processes changed. Isolated microbenchmarks, not production FPS.
dispatch.decision: Adopt process HighQoS only; P-core affinity had no stable additional gain.

cli_smoke.note: First 3 seconds, default 2 warmups/model, no qualified shot: CLI return 2 is expected.
